svg.aria-label: Four investments that change the outcome behind the statistic. First, keep girls learning: cost is the leading reason a girl leaves school, and fifty dollars covers a term. Second, adolescent-friendly health referral: one service she can reach without her family knowing, at a time she is not in class. Third, protection from coercion and violence: ask who the father is and how old he is, and keep a reporting route that works. Fourth, reintegration for young mothers: childcare, materials and follow-up for at least two terms, since only about one in three returns to school.
svg.text: Four investments that change the outcome
Scale is the easy part to share. This is the part that alters it.
Keep girls learning
Cost, not pregnancy, is the leading reason a girl
leaves school, and a girl who stays marries later
and has children later.
$50 covers a full term.
Health she can actually reach
One adolescent-friendly service, open at a time she
is not in class, staffed by someone who will not
lecture her or tell her family.
Confidentiality, said out loud.
Protection from coercion
Ask who the father is and how old he is. A sexual
act with anyone under 18 is defilement, and some
of these girls are crime victims.
A reporting route that works.
Reintegration that lasts
Only about one in three adolescent mothers returns
to school. Childcare, materials and follow-up for at
least two terms is what changes that.
Longer than one term.
Treasured Vessels Girls’ Centre · treasuredvesselsuganda.org
